title: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk the buttermilk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir gently until just combined. Lumps are okay!
Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over medium-high heat.
Pour a 1/4 cup of batter for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip.
Cook until browned on the other side. Serve warm with maple syrup.
